title: On the verge of domestication: Early use of C4 plants in the Horn of Africa
version: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

passages.quote: T’ef is considered to have been domesticated locally, but it does not appear in the macrobotanical record until ca. 400 BCE at Mezber (Tigrai, Ethiopia) and Mai Chiot (Asmara, Eritrea)
finger millet is recorded for the first time at Bieta Giyorgis (Tigrai, Ethiopia) during the Early Aksumite period (ca. 50 BCE to 150 CE)
